description: This file defines F# interfaces and types related to asynchronous operations on generic options within the namespace 'UnitTests.FSharpInterfaces'. It includes a discriminated union and an interface with a method for round-trip option processing.

methods.name: OptionRoundtrip
methods.description: An abstract method in the IFSharpParameters interface that takes an option value of type 'T' and returns a Task of an option of type 'T', representing an asynchronous operation.
